You may bring Food, Ice, Alcoholic and non-Alcoholic Drinks, also Smoking is allowed but please pre roll. Any booking at 5pm or after is considered a Night Cruise. *Available dates/time WILL NOT be held without $25 deposit. When calling to book your cruise be deposit ready or your requested time slot will be automatically canceled at close of business (5PM EST) the next day - NO EXCEPTIONS! blurb: Cheapskate Adventures offers private boat cruises on the St. Johns River and around Jacksonville, including sightseeing and dolphin watching. Cruises are private events with a maximum of 6 guests, and guests may bring food, alcohol, and smoke if pre-rolled. The company also offers jet ski rentals (details not extracted here).
